name: Future Edge AI-Exposure Model

class_meaning.E1: an AI chatbot alone can halve the time
class_meaning.E2: AI can do it with extra tools built on top

data: Eloundou et al. (2023) 'GPTs are GPTs' human exposure labels on O*NET task statements (github.com/openai/GPTs-are-GPTs, MIT licence); O*NET (CC BY 4.0)

metrics.evaluation: 5-fold cross-validation, test folds contain only occupations unseen in training
metrics.baseline: always predict the most common label (E0)
